description: Add vitamin D 2000 IU daily as home supplement
presentation: A 67-year-old man with a history of hypothyroidism presents with daily palpitations and increased fatigue. He takes vitamin D 2000 IU daily as a home supplement. Last year, a Ziopatch showed atrial fibrillation for 1 minute and 15 seconds. On exam today in the clinic, he is in normal sinus rhythm. I have referred him to Cardiology. Should I start this patient on a DOAC in anticipation for possible ablation?
